text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss
- U.S. senate approved law changes to allow permanent residency for Christoph Meili, the former security guard who uncovered unlawful shredding at UBS in Switzerland.
- The Swiss parliamentry commission for science, education and
culture rejected a bid to ban the transplantion of animal organs
- Basle will hold the 100th anniversary of the first Zionist Congress of 1897 at the end of August.
- President of the Swiss Greens Hanspeter Thuer said he would
step down both as party leader and as a member of parliament. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
